+## #2854 - Describe the shipped features and their limits in the guide
+
+**What was decided.** Update the existing guide pages for the features
+listed in #2854. Describe the current merged implementation and its tests.
+Explain the holder-reference, DXF-profile and protected-operation format
+barriers beside their workflows. Keep the AI section to a short connection
+pointer because #1949 owns the full guide.
+
+**Why.** The next documentation build must explain the controls that ship.
+Some merged slices store data without making it available for machining:
+DXF chain generation still refuses, and plasma recipes do not yet change
+operation parameters or output. The guide states these limits explicitly.
+It also follows current Report code, whose issue buttons request the
+clipboard screenshot; an older PR body described a separate copy button.
+
+**Considered and dropped.** A separate release feature page would duplicate
+the guide and split instructions between pages. A complete AI guide would
+overlap #1949. New screenshots are unnecessary for these text changes.
+No executable behavior, output golden, dependency or process file changes.
+
+**Cost to change later.** Low. These are guide text and coverage tests.
+The overlap with #2799 concerns the same files but different sections;
+the second PR to merge refreshes its branch.

+### Stored torch recipes
+
+A plasma torch can store cut-data recipes by material and exact plate
+thickness. Each recipe states its cut feed and kerf. It can also hold cut,
+pierce and transfer heights, pierce delay, puddle-jump percentage and dwell,
+amperage, arc voltage, pierce capacity and an edge-start flag. Blank
+optional values mean the controller's own table; no cut-chart values are
+supplied or inferred.
+
+Recipes enter through a project, a tool library or an MCP tool definition.
+The tool editor preserves them but has no recipe editor yet. **Stored
+recipes do not set operation parameters, toolpaths or posted output yet.**
+Continue to set the operation or controller table explicitly.
+
+A bad recipe is refused by tool name. Thickness, kerf and feed must be
+positive. Duplicate material-and-thickness entries are refused. A plate
+thicker than the stated pierce capacity requires an edge start. Material
+alone never selects a thickness recipe, and no nearest thickness is used.
+

+## Report a problem or request a feature
+
+Open **Report an issue** on the status strip, next to **Debug info**.
+Enter a short title, then choose **Report a bug** or **Request a
+feature**. CamCraft opens a prefilled GitHub issue in your browser. The
+title, diagnostic information and bug or enhancement label are filled in.
+Add what happened and the steps that reproduce it, then submit the issue
+in GitHub. Opening the browser does not submit it for you.
+
+The same button asks for a screenshot of the whole application window
+and copies it to the clipboard. Paste the image into the GitHub issue
+description. The status line confirms the copy or reports that no
+screenshot arrived. Check the open issues first to avoid a duplicate.
+
+## AI Chat connection settings
+
+Open **AI Chat** from **View > Panels**. Choose a **Provider** and a
+**Model**. Desktop builds support Anthropic, OpenAI Chat and Responses,
+Gemini, and Ollama. All local panel presets use Ollama. The panel has
+no endpoint field. For other runtimes and external agents, see the
+[AI guide](../../automate/ai/). Cloud keys come from `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`,
+`OPENAI_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY` first, then the OS keychain. Keys are not saved in the project or preferences; there
+is no key-entry control in this panel yet.
+
+**Offline only** is remembered between runs and permits only loopback
+endpoints on this computer. Turn it off to use a cloud provider. A
+nonlocal plain HTTP endpoint is refused. This is a short connection
+pointer; see the [AI guide](../../automate/ai/) for the full setup steps.

+## Place a DXF profile
+
+A DXF drawing is a profile on the stock of one setup, not a solid model.
+Create the stock first. The automation commands `import_dxf` (MCP) and
+`cam.importDxf(path, { setup, units, join_tol, name })` (script) place it
+on the stock top at the stock origin. For box and cylinder stock, that
+origin is the XY centre. A moved or resized stock carries its profile.
+
+Use `move_dxf_profile` to set X, Y and a rotation about the stock face
+normal. The profile stays on that face; it has no independent Z move.
+Import and placement changes are undoable. A drawing without units is
+refused with its width and height until you state the intended units.
+Read the import summary for skipped DXF items.
+
+**Current limit:** a 2D operation can name a profile, but generation from
+the chains is not available yet. Generate refuses by name and writes no
+toolpath. A 3D operation needs a solid model. Model-top and model-bottom
+heights have no value for a profile; use stock or fixed references.
+
+**Breaking file change:** profiles require project format version 71 or
+later. A build that reads only version 70 or earlier refuses a newer file
+instead of opening the setup without its profiles. Keep an older copy
+when you need to return to an older build.
+
+## Linked models
+
+A desktop model import from a file records a link to that source file.
+When that file changes, CamCraft imports it again through the normal
+import command. This keeps the model
+identity and makes dependent toolpaths stale. Regenerate and verify the
+job after a source change. Nothing generates or posts automatically.
+The import is one undo step. Undo keeps the old model until the file
+changes again. A missing or unreadable file keeps the model and reports
+the problem on the status line.
+
+To stop updates, right-click the model in the browser and choose
+**Unlink from** followed by its filename. Undo restores the link. MCP `set_model_link` can
+link to another path or clear the link. A moved source file needs a new
+link; there is no Link to file control in the window yet. See
+[opening a file from the command line](@/guide/automate/cli.md#open-a-file-in-the-window).
+

+"""Provenance: Guide coverage for CamCraft's own merged v0.25 features (#2854)."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import unittest
+
+
+GUIDE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "content/guide"
+
+
+def read_page(path):
+    return " ".join((GUIDE / path).read_text().lower().split())
+
+
+class GuideRefresh(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_protection_explains_file_compatibility(self):
+        for path in ("operations/operations-2d.md", "operations/operations-3d.md"):
+            with self.subTest(page=path):
+                page = read_page(path)
+                self.assertIn("do not touch", page)
+                self.assertRegex(page, r"(older|earlier) (build|version)")
+                self.assertRegex(page, r"(refuse|reject|cannot open)")
+
+    def test_dxf_placement_has_setup_and_operation_guidance(self):
+        setups = read_page("set-up/setups.md")
+        for fact in ("dxf", "stock", "undo"):
+            with self.subTest(fact=fact):
+                self.assertIn(fact, setups)
+        self.assertRegex(setups, r"(older|earlier) (build|version)")
+        self.assertIn("dxf", read_page("operations/operations-2d.md"))
+
+    def test_holder_reference_and_separate_editor_are_documented(self):
+        tools = read_page("set-up/tools.md")
+        for fact in ("library", "reference", "body", "profile", "window", "preview"):
+            with self.subTest(fact=fact):
+                self.assertIn(fact, tools)
+        self.assertRegex(tools, r"(older|earlier) (build|version)")
+
+    def test_plasma_recipes_name_material_and_thickness(self):
+        for path in ("operations/operations-plasma.md", "set-up/tools.md"):
+            with self.subTest(page=path):
+                page = read_page(path)
+                for fact in ("recipe", "material", "thickness"):
+                    with self.subTest(fact=fact):
+                        self.assertIn(fact, page)
+
+    def test_plasma_profile_starts_with_icon_and_schematic(self):
+        page = (GUIDE / "operations/operations-plasma.md").read_text()
+        profile = page.split("## Plasma Profile\n", 1)[1].lstrip()
+        first_paragraph = profile.split("\n\n", 1)[0]
+        self.assertTrue(first_paragraph.startswith('{{ <icon name="op-plasma-profile" /> }}'))
+        self.assertIn("../../../operation-paths.svg#PlasmaProfile", first_paragraph)
+        self.assertIn("### Stored torch recipes", profile)
+
+    def test_ai_chat_connection_names_panel_limits_and_guide(self):
+        page = read_page("reference/troubleshooting.md")
+        connection = page.split("## ai chat connection settings", 1)[1].split("## ", 1)[0]
+        self.assertIn("all local panel presets use ollama", connection)
+        self.assertIn("no endpoint field", connection)
+        self.assertNotIn("lm studio", connection)
+        self.assertNotIn("#1949", connection)
+        self.assertIn("[ai guide](../../automate/ai/)", connection)
+        self.assertIn("other runtimes and external agents", connection)
+
+    def test_deburr_filters_and_unreachable_edges_are_documented(self):
+        page = read_page("operations/operations-3d.md")
+        deburr = page.split("## deburr", 1)[1].split("## ", 1)[0]
+        for fact in ("picked", "excluded", "minimum", "angle", "hole", "reach"):
+            with self.subTest(fact=fact):
+                self.assertIn(fact, deburr)
+
+    def test_finish_gap_links_are_documented(self):
+        page = read_page("operations/operations-3d.md")
+        self.assertIn("gap_link", page)
+        self.assertIn("clearance", page)
+
